source.title: Demonic Deceptions
source.description:
De loa have told me of a poison gatherin' strength in Ashenvale, on the tainted land where the great demon Mannoroth was slain. Someone be drawin' power from the pit lord's remains.

They must be usin' illusions to hide their rituals. If you are to stop them, you'll be needin' protectin from their deceptions.

My tribe uses an extract from owlbeast glands in an enchantment to discern truth from lies. Collect these glands from the owlbeasts in Winterspring.
source.objective: Collect 6 Owlbeast Pineal Glands from owlbeasts in Winterspring, then return to the Shadowtooth Emissary in Felwood.
source.progress: The enchantment is almost ready, <name>. Did you bring what I asked for?
source.completion:
<The troll chants an incantation over an object, then hands it to you>
Take this, <name>. It will protect you from the demons' illusions.
